images.title: Digital roots go round in a cycle
images.purpose: Shows the digital roots of 7, 13, 19, 25, 31 cycling 7, 4, 1 on a ring of the nine roots.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. One ring of nine dots in the centre with three highlighted dots and arrows between them.
images.exact_structure: A ring of 9 small dots evenly spaced like a clock face, standing for the roots 1 to 9 in order clockwise with 9 at the top. Only the dots for 1, 4 and 7 are enlarged, filled reddish purple (#CC79A7) and numbered; the other 6 dots are small and grey (#6B7280). Three curved teal (#0072B2) arrows inside the ring go 7 to 4, 4 to 1 and 1 to 7. In the centre of the ring: 7, 13, 19, 25, 31. Nothing else in the frame.

images.takeaway: Adding the same number each time makes the digital roots repeat in a cycle.
images.description: Shows the digital roots of 7, 13, 19, 25, 31 cycling 7, 4, 1 on a ring of the nine roots.
images.context: Roots: 7, 4, 1, 7, 4. Adding 6 takes 3 from the root.
